verdict.rationale: Highnote's docs describe an integrated core ledger with real-time balances, transaction-level posting tying every authorization to settlement, and in-house daily reconciliation/settlement management (docs-3, docs-19, docs-23, docs-28, docs-33), directly matching the finance-lead's need for real-time money movement visibility and reconciliation. Missing for 10: explicit settlement reporting/export tooling with penny-level reconciliation detail and independent/hands-on corroboration of ledger accuracy.
